app.name: DayNight
app.tagline: Make your PC switch light/dark on a schedule — like a phone
app.lite_badge: Lightweight · portable · no installer · single tray · assets inside the exe
manual.title: Manual switch
manual.hint: Switch Windows light/dark now (this window follows). With a schedule on, your manual choice holds until the next period matches.
schedule.hint: Switches Windows light/dark on time so Follow-system apps (IDEs, Agent Harness, …) actually follow — easier on the eyes.
theme.mode_hint: Overall bright vs dark chrome — separate from accent color below.
theme.accent_hint: When enabled, picking a color writes the Windows accent and recolors DayNight. The title-bar/border option turns on window colorization (Explorer frames look tinted). Uncheck custom accent to restore Windows defaults; or uncheck only the border option to keep accent without colored frames.
theme.accent_on_chrome: Also color title bars / window borders (more visible)
display.gamma_hint: Useful when a laptop has no contrast OSD. Some games reset it; DayNight re-applies periodically.
display.cabc_manage: Let DayNight manage this Windows feature
display.cabc_hint: May need admin rights and a reboot. Not available on every PC.
display.cabc_reboot: Written. A reboot may be required.
general.portable_hint: Personal settings live in config.json next to DayNight.exe; locales and icons are embedded in the exe.
about.title: About DayNight
about.body: Make Windows switch light/dark on a schedule like a phone, so Follow-system apps (IDEs, Agent Harness, and more) truly follow — bright by day, easier on the eyes at night.
about.lite: Lightweight: no ads, no usage telemetry, no network uploads; config stays on this PC; single tray instance; locales and icons ship inside the exe — usually only config.json sits beside it.
